root_cause_label: Blind Algorithmic Guessing Without Image Sampling
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent failed to sample the target image's pixel content to identify the path-traced 3D scene, instead making a series of blind algorithmic guesses (Mandelbrot, Julia set, trig patterns) that bear no resemblance to the actual rendered image.
t_err_evidence: Step 4: After learning only the image dimensions from the header, the agent immediately creates image.c and begins writing code without sampling any pixel data from the image, acting on the false premise that the header alone is sufficient to reconstruct the image.
t_commit_evidence: Step 6: The agent explicitly states 'I will assume this is not the correct solution' and begins a Mandelbrot set implementation — a completely wrong algorithmic direction — without any image content evidence to guide this choice, locking in a guessing strategy that persists to the end.
trigger_explanation: The agent encountered a file-size barrier (Step 1) that prevented direct reading of the 46MB image. Rather than using alternative methods to sample pixel data (e.g., extracting specific rows/columns with head/tail/awk), the agent prematurely committed to writing code after obtaining only the image dimensions, treating the task as a guessing game rather than a reverse-engineering problem requiring actual data analysis.
